title: Brazilian Pumpkin Empanadas
description: Crispy empanadas filled with a delicious pumpkin mixture, inspired by the flavors of Brazil. Perfect as a snack or dessert.
instructions: Roll out the empanada dough to about 1/4 inch thickness.
Cut out circles of dough using a cookie cutter or the rim of a glass.
In a bowl, mix together pumpkin puree, Brazilian cheese, brown sugar, cinnamon, and salt.
Place a spoonful of the pumpkin mixture in the center of each dough circle.
Fold the dough in half to form a half-moon shape, and press the edges together to seal.
Brush the tops of the empanadas with a little bit of water, and sprinkle with additional cinnamon if desired.
Place the empanadas on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper.
Bake for 20-25 minutes, or until the empanadas are golden brown.
